notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.1 - Inventory Update Fixes
notes.content:
To every single one of you who dared to step into The Bunker, thank you.
Whether you survived the darkness or were consumed by it, your presence meant the world to us. Watching you explore, uncover secrets, scream, laugh, and share your experiences has been an absolute honor.

This game was built with heart, fear, and a lot of late nights, and seeing it come alive through your eyes makes it all worth it. Your support, feedback, and passion are what keep us going.
Thank you for playing. Thank you for believing. And thank you for being a part of this journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491040/fb6e32bebab2e078c2f81411bb93b9a88d202d3f.png

Stay brave. The darkness isn't done with you yet...

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes:

 Fixed the boxes room enemy activation.
 Fixed the skybox outside The Bunker at the ending.
 Fixed the ending credits; now the game will initiate the ending sequence.
 Fixed player surround light was too high.
 Fixed shotgun flashlight light textures.


This update does not affect your save files.

[hr][/hr]
This update does not require manual action; just restart Steam to automatically get the latest update.


As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! If you find any more bugs or issues, feel free to share them in the community or join our 🎙️ Official Discord Server.

– Cyber752 Games

notes.title: The Bunker: A Major Upgrade!
notes.content:
The long-awaited Game Save and Chapter Select, and the new Inventory System are now here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491040/1cbae0dd2e4f1b7b6451b7d60102bea4960ccb76.png

[hr][/hr]

Message from the Developer:
Your feedback and bug reports have been invaluable in helping us refine the experience and shape what’s to come. We truly appreciate every comment, suggestion, and playthrough. Your support keeps us moving forward. And for those who’ve already explored The Bunker, are you sure you've seen everything? You might want to take another look... some things are easy to miss.


[hr][/hr]

Patch Notes:

 Reworked pause menu.
 Reworked the Comms room.
 A stamina bar was added to indicate the stamina left.
 Added automatic local save system.
 Added option in the menu that loads unlocked VHS tapes (Chapters).
 Added an inventory system.
 Changed picking up and using items to adapt to the new inventory system.
 Optimized some lighting and screen shadows.
 Fixed a bug where stamina depletion can be dodged.
 Map changes and other visual improvements.


[hr][/hr]

This update does not require manual action; restart Steam to get the latest update automatically.

As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! If you find any bugs or issues, feel free to share them in the community or join our 🎙️ Official Discord Server.

– Cyber752 Games

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2 - Minor Bugs Resolved
notes.content:
🛠 We’ve just pushed a quick hotfix (v1.0.2) to address some issues that popped up after the launch. Thanks to your feedback, we were able to identify and resolve the following:



 Fixed a bug where the flashlight couldn't be acquired easily.
 A dim light was added around the player to help make way for some visibility when in complete darkness.


This update does not require manual action; just restart Steam to automatically get the latest update.

As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! If you find any more bugs or issues, feel free to share them in the community or join our 🎙️ Official Discord Server.

– Cyber752 Games

notes.title: The Bunker is OUT NOW — Enter the Darkness!
notes.content:
The Bunker has officially opened its door!
The Bunker has officially launched on Steam, and your descent into found-footage madness begins right now.

Thank you so much for your support throughout the development of The Bunker. We're incredibly grateful to everyone who played the demo, your feedback and enthusiasm truly help us continue developing games that are feared not by their graphics, but by their atmosphere!

[previewyoutube=O3oc5czddj0;full][/previewyoutube]

🔦 Key Features

 📼 Authentic Found-Footage Aesthetic: Experience a horrific facility in a grainy, distorted visual reminiscent of lost VHS tapes, enhancing the game's immersive horror atmosphere.
 🕹️ PSX-Era Low-Poly Graphics: Relive the nostalgic charm of classic horror games with meticulously crafted low-polygon environments that evoke dread and suspense.
 🧠 Atmospheric Psychological Horror: Delve into a mind-bending narrative focused on tension and unease.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487660/The_Bunker/

💸 Launch Discount – For a Limited Time!
To celebrate the release, The Bunker is 20% OFF until April 25th! 
Don't miss your chance to dive into the darkness at a discounted price before it’s too late...

☢️ How You Can Support Us?
As a small indie team, your support means the world to us. Here's how you can help:

 If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam!  
Reviews have a massive impact on indie games, and we'd love to hear what you think (and what scared you most 👀).

 Share the game with your horror-loving friends or post your reactions on social media — analog nightmares love word of mouth!

 Join our growing horror community for behind-the-scenes peeks, theories, and future updates:  
🎙️ Official Discord Server
